name: National Insurance Request For Supporting Documents
summary: Requests payslips, identity records, or other proofs so a benefit claim or insurance status can be decided.

guidance.primaryNextStep: Collect every document listed on the notice and submit them through the named channel before the deadline.
guidance.deadlineSummary: By the submission date on the notice
guidance.appliesWhen: Bituach Leumi cannot finish a claim or status review until you prove something with documents
guidance.recommendedChannel: Use the exact upload, email, fax, or branch channel listed on the request.
guidance.whenToContactAuthority: you cannot get the documents in time or the request names documents that do not fit your case
guidance.whatToVerify: Verify which claim this request belongs to, the exact document list, and the submission deadline.

sections.explainer: Case number and request type: identify the claim or insurance matter that needs evidence.
Requested documents: the precise list of evidence, such as payslips, employer confirmations or bank statements.
sections.actionRequired: Collect each listed document; if anything is missing, ask the branch how to proceed.

sections.explainer: Submission method: check the official channel and how to include your case number.
sections.actionRequired: Submit through the specified channel and keep the confirmation number or screenshot.

sections.explainer: Document deadline: the date the authority expects the material. Missing it may affect processing.
sections.actionRequired: If you cannot meet the deadline, contact the branch beforehand and ask about an extension; do not assume one has been granted.
sections.deadline: By the submission date on the notice

sections.explainer: Next steps: explains which processing actions continue after the documents arrive.

sources.title: ביטוח לאומי — איך ניתן לשלוח לכם מסמכים?
sources.scope: Explains document upload and personal-area submission. A specific request controls the document list and deadline; some documents require originals.
